items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta and full launch; keep private. Evidence shows the upstream public terms prohibit collection, use, derivative use, and public/commercial display of product listings, descriptions, and prices absent express written consent. API documentation proves access mechanics only, not redistribution rights. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, owner, and privacy evidence also remain incomplete. Recommendation: do not approve go-live, affiliate expansion, advertising, public display, or alert expansion. Prepare a draft permission request and counsel packet; obtain human counsel review before any external request or launch change. Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed; all four remain open because required evidence is not attached.

Data-use dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data—blocked because current terms conflict with proposed storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, and monetization; missing written permission, field-level rights, attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown rules. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed; repository evidence is insufficient for retention, deletion, access, correction, processor, notification consent, and unsubscribe controls. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed; privacy and cookie pages exist, but deployed consent behavior, withdrawal, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review are not evidenced. Operational logs and Cloudflare data—evidence_needed; log fields, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA coverage, incident handling, and data-subject request procedures are not evidenced. No item supports go-live approval.
